parsed.explanation: Thin trans-specific record, so extrapolation from structure governs. Positives: no documented trans-specific criminal offence, no trans-specific violence data, no documented universal facility/custody rule for visitors, foreign documents govern entry. Heavily outweighed negatives: entrenched societal hostility framed as moral threat ('imported, contrary to values'), concealment-driven community, no anti-discrimination law, no LGR (climate signal only), no organizations, no working recourse. State-tolerated targeting is documented: a domestic CSO records arrests from false same-sex accusations and law-enforcement mistreatment/torture of LGBTQ people, giving the public-morals statute an active police lever; harsh prison conditions and impunity provide the custody backdrop. Public same-sex affection is criminalized with above-average penalties, exposing a trans visitor read as in a same-sex relationship. Silence on trans-specific treatment is not safety here; documented hostility plus state mistreatment plus absent remedy places this in High Risk.
